mapper.select: SELECT c.provider_id, NULL AS provider_order_id, o.id AS order_id, o.current_status AS order_status, NULL AS lifecycle_status, o.order_no, NULL AS external_order_no, NULL AS tracking_no FROM shipment_order o JOIN logistics_channel c ON c.id=o.channel_id AND c.deleted=0 AND c.status='ACTIVE' WHERE o.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND o.id=#{orderId}

SELECT c.provider_id, p.id AS provider_order_id, o.id AS order_id, o.current_status AS order_status, p.lifecycle_status, o.order_no, p.external_order_no, p.tracking_no FROM shipment_order o JOIN logistics_channel c ON c.id=o.channel_id AND c.deleted=0 JOIN provider_order p ON p.tenant_id=o.tenant_id AND p.shipment_order_id=o.id AND p.provider_id=c.provider_id WHERE o.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND o.id=#{orderId}

SELECT p.provider_id, p.id AS provider_order_id, o.id AS order_id, o.current_status AS order_status, p.lifecycle_status, o.order_no, p.external_order_no, p.tracking_no FROM provider_order p JOIN shipment_order o ON o.id=p.shipment_order_id AND o.tenant_id=p.tenant_id WHERE p.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND p.request_id=#{requestId}

SELECT contact_name, phone, company_name, email, country_code, state_province, city, district, address_line1, address_line2, postal_code FROM shipment_address WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND shipment_order_id=#{orderId} AND address_type=#{addressType}

SELECT si.product_name, si.product_name_en, si.quantity, si.unit_price, si.currency, si.declared_value, si.sku, si.origin_country FROM shipment_item si JOIN shipment_package sp ON sp.id=si.shipment_package_id AND sp.tenant_id=si.tenant_id WHERE si.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND sp.shipment_order_id=#{orderId} ORDER BY si.item_no ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO provider_order (tenant_id, shipment_order_id, provider_id, request_id, service_code, lifecycle_status, test_flag, test_retention_until_utc) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{orderId}, #{providerId}, #{requestId}, #{serviceCode}, 'PROCESSING', #{testFlag}, #{testRetentionUntilUtc})
mapper.update: UPDATE provider_order SET request_id=#{requestId}, service_code=#{serviceCode}, lifecycle_status='PROCESSING', last_error_code=NULL, last_error_summary=NULL, test_flag=CASE WHEN #{testFlag} THEN TRUE ELSE test_flag END, test_retention_until_utc=CASE WHEN #{testFlag} AND test_retention_until_utc IS NULL THEN #{testRetentionUntilUtc} ELSE test_retention_until_utc END, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND shipment_order_id=#{orderId} AND lifecycle_status NOT IN ('PROCESSING','CANCELLED')

UPDATE provider_order SET lifecycle_status=#{lifecycleStatus}, external_order_no=COALESCE(#{externalOrderNo}, external_order_no), tracking_no=COALESCE(#{trackingNo}, tracking_no), provider_status=#{providerStatus}, last_error_code=NULL, last_error_summary=NULL, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND shipment_order_id=#{orderId} AND request_id=#{requestId} AND lifecycle_status='PROCESSING'

UPDATE provider_order SET lifecycle_status='FAILED', last_error_code=#{errorCode}, last_error_summary=#{errorSummary}, retry_count=retry_count+1, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND shipment_order_id=#{orderId} AND request_id=#{requestId} AND lifecycle_status='PROCESSING'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shipment_label (tenant_id, shipment_order_id, provider_order_id, request_id, label_reference, invoice_reference, label_status, error_code, error_summary) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{orderId}, #{providerOrderId}, #{requestId}, #{labelReference}, #{invoiceReference}, #{status}, #{errorCode}, #{errorSummary}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE request_id=VALUES(request_id), label_reference=VALUES(label_reference), invoice_reference=VALUES(invoice_reference), label_status=VALUES(label_status), error_code=VALUES(error_code), error_summary=VALUES(error_summary), updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)

INSERT INTO customs_document (tenant_id, shipment_order_id, provider_order_id, request_id, document_type, document_reference, document_status, error_code, error_summary) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{orderId}, #{providerOrderId}, #{requestId}, #{documentType}, #{reference}, #{status}, #{errorCode}, #{errorSummary}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE document_reference=VALUES(document_reference), document_status=VALUES(document_status), error_code=VALUES(error_code), error_summary=VALUES(error_summary), updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)
